Type: sofa
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Hoffman Down-Filled Performance Fabric Sofa Couch, 97"W, Grey Tweed
Colors: Grey Tweed
Materials: Wood frame; Polypropylene fabric
Whatever you need to accommodate kids, pets, spills and every other facet of a busy life, this sofa has it all: Plush comfort, stain-resistant fabric, durable construction, and a timeless look to blend with your existing styles. 97”W x 39.5”D x 37”H Solid hardwood frame with Revolution Performance Fabric Modern casual Exceptional comfort with high performance polypropylene fabric for heavy wear. No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
